research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Neptyne is researching systems and methods described as a system to provide a joint spreadsheet and electronic notebook interface. The abstract details spreadsheet formatted access to information stored within a hosted electronic notebook, enhancing usability for users familiar with spreadsheets while preserving notebook style storage and interaction. Overall, Neptyne is developing integrated spreadsheet notebook interfaces and spreadsheet based access to hosted notebook data.

about_short_description.short_description: Neptyne is a developer of spreadsheet programmable tools.

product.name: Neptyne for Google Sheets
product.description: A Google Sheets add-on that allows users to write and run Python code directly within spreadsheets, enabling custom functions and data manipulation.

product.name: Neptyne Standalone Spreadsheet
product.description: A standalone Python-based spreadsheet application that runs outside Google Sheets, offering faster performance and fewer limitations.

product.name: Neptyne Sheet Bot
product.description: An AI tool that analyzes spreadsheets to explain their structure, identify key calculations, and suggest improvements.

product.name: API Integration and Secret Management
product.description: A feature that enables secure calling of external APIs, including OpenAI and others, directly from Python code within spreadsheets.

product.name: Advanced Features for Google Sheets
product.description: Capabilities that allow Python functions to read and write arbitrary spreadsheet cells, create graphs, and insert interactive elements like buttons.
